prompt:
Create one original, production-ready 2D game asset: a green and teal defensive spacecraft with one prominent annular shield emitter integrated around its central core, a compact armored hull, and short sturdy side projections. The emitter is a technological ring attached to the ship, not a freestanding shield bubble or an extra orb.

Camera and orientation: perfect orthographic top-down plan view, with the nose pointing exactly toward the top edge of the image. No tilt, no perspective, no side view. Keep the design compact and bilaterally symmetrical, with a silhouette that remains distinguishable at small game size.

Reference 1 is attached only as a rough guide to the gameplay role and general silhouette family. Do not copy its pixel-art rendering, its orientation, its original palette, or its background. The written design brief above has priority. Do not place the reference image itself in the scene.

Style: crisp detailed non-pixel vector game art, clean hard-edged geometric contours, restrained broad panel details, and clear color blocking. Detail must remain readable and must not turn into tiny noisy greebles at small size.

Composition: exactly one single complete ship, centered and large in the frame, with clear empty margin on every side. Show the entire nose, wings, appendages, and engines without cropping. Pure uniform solid white background (#FFFFFF), with no cast shadow and no background scenery.

Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, insignia, interface, border, stars, planets, landscape, people, pilots, debris, additional ships, additional weapons, or separate objects.

references.purpose: Ориентир игровой роли и семейства силуэта; ракурс, ориентация, палитра и фон результата задаются промтом

visualCheck: Approved: original and final 256x256 RGBA inspected individually and on light/dark sheets; complete green/teal defensive ship with integrated annular shield emitter, nose up, clean alpha edges, distinct 64px silhouette.
processing: Border-connected white background removal, white-matte color recovery, background and post-resize alpha<16 cleanup, alpha crop, padding, one premultiplied-alpha LANCZOS resize, centered RGBA canvas; no upscaling

processingDetails.programmaticCheck: Passed: decoded PNG, RGBA, exact square dimensions, transparent and visible pixels, non-empty object, transparent margin on all sides, and no residual alpha values 1..15
